title: Playlist backups and a check of the transfer
description: The contents of the collection are preserved, and the entries that did not match are there to be checked.

blocks.text: Changing service makes it easy to lose the order or end up with a different version of a track. A person wants to keep their own choices, not just the number of songs.

quote.text: Gang, the fact that SOOOOOOO many of the songs I like disappear from my likes list is infuriating!

blocks.text: Take snapshots of the contents and compare the transfer against the original. Flag the recordings that are unavailable and the matches that look doubtful.
How this works depends on the supported ways of reaching the catalogs. A copy of a list grants no right to play the music and does not guarantee it exists on the new service.
